name: dsh-workspace-attach
description: DeepSeek Harness web-profile plugin: files sessions created by the ACP automation plane into a Workspace named after the directory the agent ran in, so delegated jobs stop landing in the GUI's Ungrouped bucket. Drains a request inbox and drives ctx.workspaceRegistry (create + attachSession) inside the GUI process, which is the only writer of the durable workspace account.
